content.text:
另一个循环结构是**for**循环。
一个for循环能让你有效地编写一个需要执行**特定次数**的循环。
**语法：**
content.text_html:
Another loop structure is the **for **loop. A for loop allows you to efficiently write a loop that needs to execute a specific number of times. Syntax:

另一个循环结构是**for **循环。一个for循环允许你有效地编写一个需要执行特定次数的循环。 语法：

content.text:
**初始条件**：表达式在循环的开始阶段只执行一次。
**条件判断**：每次循环迭代时都会被执行。循环重复执行该语句，直到该条件返回false。
**条件变量更改**：在循环的每次迭代后执行，一般为自增或自减。

下面的例子是打印数字1到5：
content.text_html:
Initialization: Expression executes only once during the beginning of loop Condition: Is evaluated each time the loop iterates. The loop executes the statement repeatedly, until this condition returns false. Increment/Decrement: Executes after each iteration of the loop.

The following example prints the numbers 1 through 5.

初始化：表达式在循环的开始阶段只执行一次。 条件：每次循环迭代时都会被评估。循环重复执行该语句，直到该条件返回错误。 增量/减量：在循环的每次迭代后执行。

下面的例子是打印数字1到5。

content.text: 该语句将`x`初始化为1，并重复打印`x`的值，直到条件`x<=5`的判断结果变为假。在每次循环中，语句`x++`被执行，使`x`递增1。
content.text_html:
This initializes x to the value 1, and repeatedly prints the value of x, until the condition x<=5 becomes false. On each iteration, the statement x++ is executed, incrementing x by one.

该语句将x初始化为1，并重复打印x的值，直到条件x<=5变为假。在每个迭代中，语句x++被执行，使x递增1。

content.text: 注意语法中初始化和条件判断后面的分号`;`。
content.text_html:
Notice the semicolon (;) after initialization and condition in the syntax.

你得到的代码是以进入大学的学生人数作为输入。

完成该程序，对每个学生输出 "**Welcome**"。

[s0l0!-header][h1]For Loops [/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given code that takes the number of students who enter the university as input. Let's greet them!

[b]Task[/b]
Complete the program to output "Welcome" [b]for each student.[/b]

[b]Sample Input[/b]
2

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Welcome
Welcome

[note]Remember the [b]semicolon (;)[/b] after initialization and condition in the syntax.[/note]

resolved.title: for 循环
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]for Loops[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can have any type of condition and any type of increment statements in the for loop.
The example below prints only the even values between 0 and 10: [code format="java" codeId="741"][b]for[/b](int x=0; x<=10; x=x+2) {
  System.out.println(x);
}
/*
0
2
4
6
8
10
*/[/code]
[note]A [b]for [/b]loop is best when the starting and ending numbers are known.[/note]
